description: This file defines the MessageSerializer class responsible for serializing and deserializing Message objects in Orleans runtime messaging system. It handles reading from and writing to byte streams, managing message headers, bodies, and associated metadata.

classes.name: MessageSerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of Orleans Runtime Message objects, including reading and writing message headers, bodies, and associated metadata for network transmission.

classes.name: MessageBufferWriter
classes.description: A wrapper around PrefixingBufferWriter implementing IBufferWriter<byte> to facilitate message buffering.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read a message from the input byte sequence, parsing headers and body if enough data is available.

methods.name: ReadBodyObject
methods.description: Deserializes the body object of a message based on the response type.

methods.name: GetRawCodec
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ResponseCodec for a given response type.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a Message object into a byte stream using a PipeWriter.

methods.name: ThrowIfLengthsInvalid
methods.description: Validates message header and body lengths against configured maximums.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the header fields of a Message into a binary format.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes header fields of a Message from a binary format.

methods.name: ReadCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Reads a list of GrainAddressCacheUpdate from the message, used for cache invalidation.

methods.name: WriteCacheInvalidationHeaders
methods.description: Writes cache invalidation information into the message.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a UTF8 string from the message input, handling null and empty cases.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Writes a UTF8 string into the message output, handling null values.

methods.name: WriteRequestContext
methods.description: Serializes the request context dictionary into the message.

methods.name: ReadRequestContext
methods.description: Deserializes the request context dictionary from the message.

methods.name: ReadGrainId
methods.description: Reads a GrainId object from the message.

methods.name: WriteGrainId
methods.description: Writes a GrainId object into the message.
